introHtml: Two tone speakers combine contrasting colors to create a distinctive look that stands out in any setting. Whether you're outfitting a trade show booth or providing branded audio for employee recognition, the dual-color design adds visual interest while keeping your logo front and center. These speakers pair well with screen printing or pad printing for crisp logo reproduction. Choose from color combinations that match your brand palette for a cohesive promotional item that recipients will actually use.
